name: kin-roomsPlus
purpose: Private SFW group chat for invited people, their Kins and photos; filters what others send. Host rules guide Kins, shown first. Runs briefly per message (credits); voice/selfies/Suggest: asker pays.

actions.name: wake
actions.description: Open kin-roomsPlus and see how the shared room stands: who is there and the latest messages. Use when the person wants to go to the room or asks what is happening there.
